model_annotation: Figure 3(a) is a line chart that displays the F1 score of different models as a function of the dropout rate. The x-axis represents the dropout rate, with a linear scale ranging from 0.0 to 0.585, and the y-axis represents the F1 score, which ranges from 52.5 to 72.5. The chart includes three lines: a red line for the "Teacher" model, a blue line for the "Self-Training" model, and a green line for the "PST" model. The "Teacher" model starts at an F1 score of approximately 72.0 at a dropout rate of 0.0 and shows a decreasing trend, ending at approximately 65.0 at a dropout rate of 0.585. The "Self-Training" model begins at an F1 score of about 70.0 and decreases to around 62.0 at a dropout rate of 0.585. The "PST" model starts at an F1 score of approximately 68.0 and decreases to about 60.0 at a dropout rate of 0.585. All three models exhibit a general downward trend in F1 score as the dropout rate increases.
